description: Latest HbA1c (%) auto-synced from the most recent CRM Lab Profile row. Read-only headline metric for list/sort; full lab history lives in the Lab child table.
label: Latest HbA1c
name: CRM Lead-custom_latest_hba1c

description: The telephony tenant that placed/received this call (set on outbound by routing, on inbound by DID match). Used to pick the right token for recording fetch.
label: Telephony Account
name: CRM Call Log-custom_telephony_account

description: The provider that delivers this account's traffic; an account whose provider has no registered send adapter is never routed to.
label: Provider
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_provider

label: Provider Credentials (outbound — the CRM calls the provider)
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_section_credentials

description: The tenant's WABA number in digits, with the country code and no '+' (e.g. 919558240583); shown as the outbound 'From' number.
label: Channel Number (WATI)
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_wati_channel_number

description: Created by the 'Generate Webhook Token' button above: click it, save, then use 'Copy Webhook URL' and register that URL with the provider. It proves the caller is the provider and tells the CRM which account the message arrived on. Blank means inbound is off.
label: Webhook Token
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_token

description: The provider's webhook carries a URL, and the CRM downloads the image or document a patient sent from it. Listing the provider's media hosts here means the CRM downloads from those hosts only, so a forged webhook cannot point the server at a URL of the attacker's choosing. Blank allows any public host (private and internal addresses are always blocked).
label: Media Host Allowlist (SSRF)
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_media_host_allowlist

description: This agent's Acefone agent/follow-me number (digits). Used to map inbound calls to the Frappe user and as the bridge leg for click-to-call.
label: Acefone Number
name: CRM Telephony Agent-acefone_number

description: Same mobile number is also a lead in these product lines / programs (agent awareness). Computed live.
label: Other Products
name: CRM Lead-custom_patient_other_programs
options: ("; ".join(sorted({(r.custom_vertical or "?") + " / " + (r.custom_current_program or "?") for r in frappe.get_all("CRM Lead", filters={"mobile_no": doc.mobile_no, "name": ["!=", doc.name or ""]}, fields=["custom_vertical","custom_current_program"], ignore_permissions=True)}))) if doc.mobile_no else ""

description: The lead's lifecycle stage — the leaf a rep picks (a selectable CRM Lead Stage scoped to the lead's program). Set via the header Stage pill. For flat grains (e.g. Anaya, TatvaPractice) this is the only stage field used; the native CRM Lead Status field is hidden.
label: Sub-stage
name: CRM Lead-custom_substage

description: Read-only parent stage, auto-derived from custom_substage's substage_of. Populated only for grains with a two-level ladder (parent + substages); blank for flat grains where the sub-stage is the only level.
label: Stage
name: CRM Lead-custom_stage

description: Height in feet auto-synced from the most recent CRM Lab Profile row. Read-only; feeds the virtual BMI.
label: Height (ft)
name: CRM Lead-custom_height_feet

description: Body Mass Index, computed (not stored) from the synced Height (ft) and Weight (kg). feet -> metres = ft * 0.3048; BMI = kg / m^2. Blank until both are present.
label: BMI
name: CRM Lead-custom_bmi
options: frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_weight_kg) / (frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_height_feet) * 0.3048 * frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_height_feet) * 0.3048) if (frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_height_feet) and frappe.utils.flt(doc.custom_weight_kg)) else None

description: Lead warmth (single-select picklist). Defaults Hot/Cold; extend by adding options via Customize Form or this fixture.
label: Lead Temperature
name: CRM Lead-custom_lead_temperature

description: Date of the most recent CRM Lab Profile row, auto-synced. Read-only headline metric for sorting by report recency.
label: Last Report Date
name: CRM Lead-custom_last_report_date

description: Age in completed years, computed (not stored) from custom_dob. Blank if no DOB.
label: Age
name: CRM Lead-custom_age

description: Weight in kg auto-synced from the most recent CRM Lab Profile row. Read-only; feeds the virtual BMI.
label: Weight (kg)
name: CRM Lead-custom_weight_kg

description: Latest fasting blood sugar (mg/dL) auto-synced from the most recent CRM Lab Profile row. Read-only headline metric.
label: Latest FBS
name: CRM Lead-custom_latest_fbs

description: Tick if this program uses the Drug Program (chemo-cycle) profile. Drives the lead Data-tab section gate. Config, not code — a new oncology program just ticks this.
label: Is Drug Program
name: CRM Program-custom_is_drug_program

description: Set when this file's bytes live in Azure Blob, not on local disk.
label: Uploaded to Azure
name: File-custom_uploaded_to_azure

description: WATI internal message id of the WhatsApp media this file came from. The join key Refresh uses to re-link a file without duplicating it.
label: WhatsApp Message ID
name: File-custom_wa_message_id

description: WATI/Meta delivery failure reason, captured on refresh (e.g. quality restriction, OAuthException).
label: Failed Reason
name: WhatsApp Message-custom_failed_reason

description: provider message id (the provider's internal `id`). The ONE identity present on every provider path — live webhook AND getMessages history — so ingest + backfill de-duplicate on it (the webhook's whatsappMessageId is absent from history). Stamped on every ingested/backfilled row; never set on rows we originate.
label: Provider Message ID
name: WhatsApp Message-custom_provider_message_id

description: Dedup key for an LSQ activity migrated into this CRM Task (the unified activity engine routes LSQ activities to CRM Task, not FCRM Note). Indexed.
label: LSQ Activity ID
name: CRM Task-custom_lsq_activity_id

description: Engine-written JSON of the activity form values not mapped to a first-class column. Read-only — activity.api.save_activity is the only writer.
label: Activity Payload
name: CRM Task-custom_activity_payload

description: Unified read-only Activity & Location view (clinic anchor card + visit log with Google static-map thumbnails), rendered by the crm_lead_activity_location Client Script from location.api.lead_location_view.
label: Activity & Location
name: CRM Lead-custom_activity_timeline_html

description: Doctor-clinic anchor latitude, set on the first in-person capture. Engine-written.
label: Clinic Latitude
name: CRM Lead-custom_clinic_latitude

description: Doctor-clinic anchor longitude, set on the first in-person capture. Engine-written.
label: Clinic Longitude
name: CRM Lead-custom_clinic_longitude

description: Read-only Leaflet map of the clinic anchor (native Geolocation, no API key).
label: Clinic Location
name: CRM Lead-custom_clinic_geo

description: How the clinic anchor was set: doctor address (geocoded), first GPS capture, or a manager re-anchor. Engine-written.
label: Clinic Anchor Source
name: CRM Lead-custom_clinic_source
options:
Doctor Address
First GPS Capture
Manager Re-anchor

description: The clinic geofence anchor address. Set ONLY via the 'Set Clinic Location' search (which resolves lat/long); read-only here so free text can't desync from the coordinates.
label: Clinic Address (geofence anchor)
name: CRM Lead-custom_clinic_address

description: Read-only Leaflet map of the captured visit location (native Geolocation, no API key).
label: Location Map
name: CRM Task-custom_location_geo

description: Field-sales: the activity type auto-raised as the first open task when a lead on this program is assigned (gated by the 'followup' switch in CRM Tatva Automation). Blank = nothing auto-raised.
label: First Activity Type
name: CRM Program-custom_first_activity_type

description: External reference id captured by an activity (e.g. Order ID). Routed here via the schema field's target.
label: Reference
name: CRM Task-custom_reference

description: Generic domain date 1 — labelled per activity type by its schema field.
label: Key Date 1
name: CRM Task-custom_key_date_1

description: Generic domain date 2 — labelled per activity type by its schema field.
label: Key Date 2
name: CRM Task-custom_key_date_2

description: Generic domain date 3 — labelled per activity type by its schema field.
label: Key Date 3
name: CRM Task-custom_key_date_3

description: Generic domain date 4 — labelled per activity type by its schema field.
label: Key Date 4
name: CRM Task-custom_key_date_4

description: The caller's own reference for this record, echoed back on every read. It is a free-form label of the partner's choosing: the CRM stores it and never interprets it. It does not identify the record and does not deduplicate — records are addressed by `name`, the row's primary key.
label: External ID
name: CRM Task-custom_external_id

description: Partner-supplied document category for an uploaded file (e.g. prescription, lab_report). Free text — not a master.
label: File Type
name: File-custom_file_type

description: Review verdict mirrored onto the file: blank (not in review), Pending, Approved, or Rejected. Drives the Attachments badge.
label: Review Status
name: File-custom_review_status

description: Ingestion channel that created this file: Partner API, WhatsApp, Intake, or Desk. Lets a review rule scope by source.
label: Source Channel
name: File-custom_source

description: Back reference to the Document Review task raised for this file, so the verdict can be mirrored back onto the file on disposition.
label: Review Task
name: File-custom_review_task

description: The caller's own reference for this record, echoed back on every read. It is a free-form label of the partner's choosing: the CRM stores it and never interprets it. It does not identify the record and does not deduplicate — records are addressed by `name`, the row's primary key.
label: External ID
name: File-custom_external_id

description: The caller's own reference for this record, echoed back on every read. It is a free-form label of the partner's choosing: the CRM stores it and never interprets it. It does not identify the record and does not deduplicate — records are addressed by `name`, the row's primary key.
label: External ID
name: CRM Call Log-custom_external_id

description: The caller's own reference for this record, echoed back on every read. It is a free-form label of the partner's choosing: the CRM stores it and never interprets it. It does not identify the record and does not deduplicate — records are addressed by `name`, the row's primary key.
label: External ID
name: FCRM Note-custom_external_id

description: The provider's own id for this call (Acefone `call_id`, and the equivalent for any other provider). This is the key every telephony path dedupes on: a provider re-sends a CDR, and an answered trigger is later superseded by its hangup, and both must land on this one row. It is held in its own column and NEVER in the row's `name`, so the naming series can change without breaking call ingestion. Blank on a call a rep logged by hand.
label: Provider Call ID
name: CRM Call Log-custom_provider_call_id

description: Grain axis for CRM Lead assignment routing. Mandatory only for CRM Lead rules; matched against the lead grain by the Assignment Rule override (apply_assign). Other document types are unaffected.
label: Grain Product Line
name: Assignment Rule-grain_vertical

description: Grain axis for CRM Lead assignment routing. Mandatory only for CRM Lead rules; matched against the lead grain by the Assignment Rule override (apply_assign). Other document types are unaffected.
label: Grain Group
name: Assignment Rule-grain_group

description: Grain axis for CRM Lead assignment routing. Mandatory only for CRM Lead rules; matched against the lead grain by the Assignment Rule override (apply_assign). Other document types are unaffected.
label: Grain Program
name: Assignment Rule-grain_program

description: The caller's own reference for this record, echoed back on every read. It is a free-form label of the partner's choosing: the CRM stores it and never interprets it. It does not identify the record and does not deduplicate — records are addressed by `name`, the row's primary key.
label: External ID
name: CRM Lead-custom_external_id

label: Inbound Webhook (the provider calls the CRM)
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_section_ingress

description: Set during a rotation; both tokens authenticate until this one is cleared, so no live delivery is rejected mid-rotation.
label: Previous Webhook Token
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_token_previous

description: Derived, never entered. A Password field cannot be indexed, so this digest is what makes authentication one read rather than a scan and decrypt of every account.
label: Token Digest
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_token_hash

description: The token is always enforced; HMAC is added only for a provider that signs its payloads, which WATI does not.
label: Authentication
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_auth_mode

description: The header carrying the provider's signature, e.g. X-Signature.
label: Signature Header
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_hmac_header

description: Stripped before comparison, e.g. 'sha256='. Left blank when the provider sends a bare signature.
label: Signature Prefix
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_hmac_prefix

description: Rejects any inbound call that does not come from an address listed below. Leave it off unless the provider publishes fixed addresses — a wrong list silently drops every message. It cannot be turned on while the list is empty.
label: Enforce IP Allowlist
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_enforce_ip

description: One IP address or CIDR range per line, e.g. 13.234.10.5 or 13.234.0.0/16. Anything after a # is ignored. Read only when Enforce IP Allowlist is ticked.
label: Allowed Addresses
name: WhatsApp Account-custom_webhook_ip_allowlist

label: Due-Soon Reminder Sent For
name: CRM Task-custom_due_soon_notified_for
description: Derived, never entered. The due date the rep was last warned about, so one task is warned once — and warned again if it is rescheduled.

label: Overdue Notice Sent For
name: CRM Task-custom_overdue_notified_for
description: Derived, never entered. The due date the rep was last told was overdue, so a task never nags on every sweep.
